evidence.summary: Sensor data for U028 (cycle 114) shows position_error_um at 4.879 µm vs baseline 2.773 µm (75.9% increase, z=5.5) with a steady upward trend; coolant_pressure_bar and outlet_pressure_bar are only marginally above baseline.
RUL estimate indicates 55.4 cycles remaining, policy band 'above_50_monitor', suggesting the unit is still within normal life but should be monitored.
SOP-E-302 §1 describes position error increasing slowly and steadily over many cycles as a symptom of axis calibration drift.

report.summary: U028 exhibited a significant rise in position_error_um (75.9% above baseline) with a steady trend, while other sensors remain near normal. This pattern matches the symptoms of calibration drift per SOP-E-302. RUL is still acceptable but monitoring is advised. Recommend performing an axis calibration to correct drift.
